doc.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025

title: Photo with T-Bone Walker and a toy saxophone
summary: Rowe asks about a record sleeve photo; DeJohnette says it shows him with T-Bone Walker playing a toy saxophone you sing into.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: It’s a real pleasure to talk to you and I congratulate you on your career. I wanted to start out with something which I just came across, with this particular album of yours which was in our music library for DJs at the college radio station.

And someone had written on the bottom, this is an odd sort of compliment, “susceptible to rip-off, lock it up” which meant the DJs really liked it and they were worried about someone walking away with it.
There’s a picture inside, I wanted to ask you about. Down in the corner it looks like you, is that you playing into a microphone.
With T-Bone Walker. What were you —
Were you playing a recorder or something?
Oh it was one of those toy saxophones.
You play into it and you sang, you know, sang the melody.
